paper_title: Helioscope Bounds on Hidden Sector Photons
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing parameter chi, dimensionless (plot y-axis is Log10 chi; emitted values are chi itself)
notes: Redondo (arXiv:0801.1527): combined exclusion envelope on kinetic mixing chi vs hidden photon mass, from (i) reinterpretation of CAST 2007 helioscope data (dominant for ~3 meV - 1 eV, slope -2 below m~0.01 eV where oscillations incomplete, slope -1 up to ~1 eV) and (ii) solar luminosity/lifetime argument (dominant 1 eV - 40 keV, reaching chi ~ 1e-14 at m ~ 295 eV where resonant production occurs at solar core; degrades above 295 eV to bulk-emission plateau, cutoff ~40 keV). No numeric table is given; data points are approximate reconstructions of Fig. 6 using scaling relations and normalizations stated in text (e.g. W = 8e43 + 1.4e43 chi^2 (m/eV)^4 W vs L_sun = 3.83e26 W; CAST flux limit 1e-5 /cm^2/s/keV with F1 fit). Values in the 1 eV - 40 keV lifetime region are less reliable (~factor few). Not a dark matter search, so no local DM density assumption.
